title: Insiders vouch for Dan Sherman's Above Black

tellings.quote: only read that book specifically because it was told to me by insiders that it was a credible disclosure

plain: Above Black, a book by Dan Sherman, a former Air Force intelligence man who says he served in a secret program, was described to the former Pentagon official Matthew Brown by insiders as a credible disclosure, a true account of hidden matters. Brown tells Michels he read the book only because those insiders told him that. If true, people inside the government would be quietly vouching for Sherman's story.
